greet.speaker: whisper
greet.text: Don't shoot. I have been in the rafters since Halden's crew came through. I watched the hive eat them, and I watched you not get eaten, and that is the first interesting thing this station has done. I am Whisper. I am nobody's, currently, and I would like to stay that way somewhere with walls.

choices.text: [Corporate] I know the recall band. I was on a list like it once.
Why were you in the rafters?
[Splicekin] I know a recall when I hear one. Same band?

why.speaker: whisper
why.text: Someone on my line's band is sending a recall. Every asset of my gene-line that hears it walks home to be wiped and reissued. I can hear it. I am not walking. This relay was the loudest place to hear it and the best place to hide from it, and you cannot hide from a thing and listen to it at once. So: I come with you, and we find the sender.

choices.text: Come with us. We will find who is sending it.
Dax, you have hired people. Your read?
We do not carry corporate property.

dax_read.speaker: dax
dax_read.text: She hasn't lied yet. Everyone who came at us in the yard lied in the first sentence. Hire her.

refused.speaker: whisper
refused.text: You changed your mind, or the recall got louder for you too?

loyalty.speaker: whisper
loyalty.text: Tal has a terminal in the Shards. Not Tal; a terminal with his hand on the other end. From it I could do three things to my line and I have not decided which. I would like you standing there while I do not decide.

recruited.speaker: whisper
recruited.text: The recall is quieter when you are between me and it. I have not decided what that means.

choices.text: It means you picked the right side of the room.
